content: Therapeutic ultrasound is a treatment modality that utilizes high-frequency sound waves to deliver mechanical energy to tissues. This technique has been explored as a potential intervention for managing chronic rhinosinusitis, a condition characterized by persistent inflammation of the nasal and sinus mucosa. The application of ultrasound in this context aims to enhance tissue healing, reduce inflammation, and improve sinus drainage. By promoting localized microcirculation and stimulating cellular repair mechanisms, therapeutic ultrasound may offer symptomatic relief and support the resolution of chronic sinus pathology.
